title: Implement atomic worker claim and bounded failure

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Worker claim tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_worker_claims.py

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-processing.md#atomic-claim-and-bounded-failure RED: no processing-owned claim/failure boundary can atomically advance the durable queue; GREEN: controlled rows prove oldest eligible claim, exact attempt increments, two safe pending returns, terminal failed on claim three and current-operation cleanup with no lease/jobs machinery; decisive comparison: state, count, timestamps, bounded error and runtime singleton match after every transaction; artifact: isolated database transition timeline.
purpose: Provide the complete owner-valid claim/requeue/exhaustion state machine for the one sequential Photo worker.
success_outcome: The oldest eligible pending row claims atomically, increments once, and every failure either safely requeues or reaches failed on claim three while clearing current operation.
anti_goals: Do not implement inference, derivatives, terminal ready/no_faces publication, leases, fencing, SKIP LOCKED or another queue.
Do not add priority, preemption, claim tokens, job history or worker coordination.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: A claim cannot close through its bounded outcome without an extra queue or coordination mechanism.
More than one configured worker or overlapping claims become required.

constraints: Use one atomic PostgreSQL claim and one configured worker.
Bound safe last_error; never persist traceback, credential, model path or object key.
Tests use task-unique rows, controlled timestamps, safe rerun and owner-bounded cleanup.
invariants: Only pending claims to processing and attempt_count increments exactly once per claim.
Failures one and two return to pending; failure three is terminal failed.
Every outcome clears the narrow current operation without adding operation history.
verification_targets: Controlled transaction proof covers oldest eligible claim, competing ineligible rows, two requeues, third failure, safe error text and repeated fixture cleanup.
